# text-processing.com

> A Python NLTK-powered API for sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, stemming, POS tagging, and comprehensive natural language processing tasks.

text-processing.com provides both interactive demos and RESTful API endpoints for core NLP operations. Built on NLTK and accessible via HTTP POST, it serves as a practical gateway to common text processing workflows with multilingual support.

## Key Topics

- NLTK
- sentiment-analysis
- named-entity-recognition
- stemming
- POS tagging
- text-classification
- API reference
- natural-language-processing
- HTTP POST
- Python
- phrase extraction
- tokenization
- multilingual support
- JSON
- text-mining

## API Reference

- [API Documentation Index](https://text-processing.com/docs/index.html): Main API documentation with getting started guide and overview of all endpoints
- [Sentiment Analysis API](https://text-processing.com/docs/sentiment.html): HTTP POST endpoint for sentiment classification with examples and parameters
- [Stemming API](https://text-processing.com/docs/stem.html): Stemming endpoint supporting Porter, Lancaster, and Snowball algorithms
- [POS Tagging & Chunking API](https://text-processing.com/docs/tag.html): Part-of-speech tagging and IOB chunking using NLTK and Brill tagger
- [Phrase Extraction & NER API](https://text-processing.com/docs/phrases.html): Named entity recognition and phrase extraction with CoNLL2002 support
- [Complete API Documentation](https://text-processing.com/docs): Full API reference documentation for text-processing.com API 1.0

## Interactive Demos

- [Sentiment Analysis Demo](https://text-processing.com/demo/sentiment): Interactive sentiment classification demo using Naive Bayes text classifiers
- [POS Tagging & NER Demo](https://text-processing.com/demo/tag): Interactive demonstration of part-of-speech tagging, chunking, and named entity recognition
- [Stemming & Lemmatization Demo](https://text-processing.com/demo/stem): Compare Porter, Lancaster, and Snowball stemming algorithms interactively
- [Word Tokenization Demo](https://text-processing.com/demo/tokenize): Test multiple tokenizer types for splitting and processing text
- [NLP Demos Overview](https://text-processing.com/demo): Collection of interactive Python NLTK demos for core NLP tasks

## Support & FAQ

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://text-processing.com/docs/faq.html): Common questions about sentiment analysis, stemming, NER, and API usage patterns
